en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a panoramic view of a small European town in a hilly landscape. In the foreground are wooden barns and paths lined with young trees, with a couple of figures walking on a path. Behind them rises a cluster of multi‑storey houses and village buildings. Dominating the skyline is a large church with a tall tower and dome. The caption "Lauenstein i. sächs. Erzgebirge." is printed in red at the top left; there is also a small red printer's credit at the bottom right.
